title: Lethe
author: Pritha Chakraborty
text:
Complete oblivion,
or do wisps of memory lurk
in the shadows?

Down flows the tide—

Eternal amnesia
or reminiscences?
Ero and Thanatos
engage in a violent duel,
desolation
while the warm wine spills from the brimming goblet.
Conjecture is eternal.

Daughter of Eris
You are indeed an offspring of
Strife.

The boat sways
does it set sail?
